question: Does the permit term stated on the authorization cover page—effective December 1, 2021 and expiring November 30, 2026—establish December 1 through November 30 as the permit-year boundary for determining which permit-year-dependent effluent limits and monitoring requirements apply to periods within Federal FY2025?
semantic_arguments: The cover page anchors the authorization with a fixed effective date of December 1, 2021 and an expiration at midnight November 30, 2026.
Purpose B requires evaluating monitoring requirements that depend on permit year within Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30).
Purpose A requires matching reported measurements to applicable enforceable numeric limits by monitoring period within the same Federal FY2025 window.
Federal FY2025 does not align with December–November anniversaries; if permit years follow the cover-page term dates, FY2025 spans portions of two distinct permit-year tranches.

Alternative readings—calendar year, federal fiscal year, or no permit-year boundary derivable from the cover dates—would assign different permit-year-governed limits and monitoring requirements to sub-periods within FY2025.
notes: The target span cross-references Parts I–IV for substantive limits and requirements but does not define permit year; the cover-page effective and expiration dates are the only temporal anchors in the passage that could govern permit-year periodization for FY2025 evaluation.
